title: GET /api/agent/events stream messages
description: The JSON in the data: line of each event. Event 'hello' is sent first (the stream is open), event 'request' once per pending request (all pending ones on connect, new ones the moment they are queued). Comment lines (': heartbeat') every ~25 s keep proxies from closing an idle stream and carry no data.

approval.description: Only on prompt_details_update: IT's one-time approval code. Sent back in user.request's confirm, it lets the user save their details once without the IT PIN (same employee ID, within 24 hours).
